observable_outcome: Two independent pairwise RAG campaigns (gpt-4o vs DeepSeek-high, then gpt-4o vs DeepSeek-xhigh) each emit an evidence-complete development verdict or HOLD without a model-quality claim; Campaign A (high) must complete with a trustworthy harness before Campaign B (xhigh) spends.
non_goals: True 3-arm matrix or joint multi-arm statistical gate
Use Luna as an answer arm
384k DeepSeek output unless a later budget decision
Combine the two pairwise p-values into a single winner claim
examples: Each campaign retrieves 62 cases once, answers both arms for three repeats on identical contexts.

Baseline arm prod-4o uses Azure gpt-4o with harness_output_cap 16384; DeepSeek arm uses request slug deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731 with attested DeepInfra effective harness_output_cap 65536 for both high and xhigh.
OpenRouter route policy pins only DeepInfra; reasoning.effort is frozen and applied on every candidate answer call (not ambient default).
Harness smoke (before gpt-4o is provisioned): Campaign A may use attested gpt-4o-mini vs DeepSeek high with 32768 cap at low effort or 65536 at high/xhigh and frozen reasoning.effort=high.
Campaign A uses candidate-effort=high; Campaign B uses xhigh; harness cap is identical so effort is the only free variable.
Ops failures use answer-opportunity denominator; harness_output_cap hits are zero-scored and labeled as harness caps not model limits.
Live spend requires cold_independent APPROVE bound to the exact runtime commit; waivers cap ledger at IMPLEMENTED.
Per-attempt campaign_cap_usd is 25; phase rag_repair 55; global TOTAL_CAP_USD 60.
